ui.مفتوح المصدر · بايثون وحده · بلا خادم ول: Open source · Python only · No server, no dependencies
ui.نظام تشغيل لفريق <em>وكلاء</em> الذكاء ا: An operating system for a team of AI agents
ui.أمر واحد يحوّل مجلدًا عاديًا إلى مكتب عم: One command turns an ordinary folder into a disciplined office: a single board every agent works from, an independent quality gate, decision governance, performance indicators that export as CSV, and a management site that runs from one file.
ui.اللغة المفضلة هي لغة إدارة النظام كاملًا: The preferred language is the language for managing the entire system, and it is the one used with the employees: the team addresses you in it and writes outputs and reports in it. It is included in the install command and preselected in the wizard, where you can change it. Each employee can work on a different platform.
ui.المحادثات مع الذكاء الاصطناعي تنسى، وتتع: AI chats forget, contradict one another, and are never measured. Project Forge makes the folder the memory, the board the shared mind, and the numbers the judge.
ui.صفوف مرقمة بحالاتها ومتطلباتها ومواعيدها: Numbered rows with their statuses, requirements and deadlines. Each agent reads the board and edits only its own rows, on any platform.
ui.رئيس ضمان الجودة يحكم «يمر أو لا يمر» قب: The Head of Quality Assurance rules "pass or fail" before any output reaches you. The pass rate is a measured indicator.
ui.سقف خمسة قرارات مفتوحة، ومهلة 48 ساعة تؤ: A cap of five open decisions, a 48-hour window after which the recommendation is taken, and a tagged decision log: reversible or not.
ui.أمر <code>report</code> يعطيك نسبة التسل: The report command gives you the delivery rate, cycle time and load per role, and export exports them as CSV.
ui.كل كتابة في اللوحة تُسجَّل: من، ومتى، وم: Every write to the board is logged: who, when and what. Every status change is kept to calculate cycle time.
ui.تصنيف البيانات والأدوات المعتمدة ملف ملز: Data classification and approved tools form a binding file for every agent: no personal data in an unapproved tool.
ui.موقع إدارة من ملف واحد: A management site in one file
ui.مركز الصباح والمهام والفريق والمخطط والأ: Morning center, tasks, team, diagram and upcoming commands, running with no server in light, dark and on mobile.
ui.من الاستراتيجية إلى المطاعم والعقارات وا: From strategy to restaurants, real estate, Hajj and Umrah, and university theses. Describe your project in a sentence and the tool suggests the closest match, with more than 330 roles you add in one click and ready-made skills.
ui.لا يكتب فوق ملف موجود، والكتابة ذرّية، و: It never overwrites an existing file, writes are atomic, and board writes are guarded by a fingerprint that prevents two agents from colliding.
ui.كل مشروع يولّد تقريرًا يمكن الدفاع عنه أ: Every project produces a report you can defend in front of management, not an impression.
ui.المسلّم والمعتمد من كل المهام، والمسلّم: Delivered and approved tasks out of all tasks, and what was delivered in the last seven days.
ui.متوسط الزمن من إحالة الصف إلى تسليمه، من: Average time from a row being assigned to being delivered, from the real status history.
ui.ما مرّ من بوابة ضمان الجودة مقابل ما أُع: What passed the quality gate versus what was sent back for revision.
ui.الصفوف المفتوحة لكل دور، وتنبيه عند تجاو: Open rows per role, with an alert when the cap is exceeded.
ui.عمر كل قرار معلق، وتنبيه عند تجاوز 48 سا: The age of each pending decision, with an alert past 48 hours.
ui.أربعة ملفات CSV: اللوحة والفريق والقرارا: Four CSV files: the board, the team, the decisions and the indicators, with assignment and delivery dates.
Three steps, then the work continues from the board.
ui.أربعة أسئلة: الاسم، والهدف، وكيف تُخاطَب: Four questions: the name, the goal, how you want to be addressed, and a one-sentence description of your project. The tool suggests the closest of 80 specialisations, and you adjust roles and skills by clicking, with an explanation at every step.
ui.افتح محادثة لكل موظف: Open a chat for each employee
Copy the start command from the site or the library. The employee reads its role from the folder and works on the board.
ui.موقع الإدارة يعرض ما ينتظرك ومن يعمل الآ: The management site shows what is waiting for you and who is working now. At the end of the week: report for the report and export for CSV files.
ui.سطر واحد تلصقه فيُنزّل الأداة ويفتح صفحة: One line you paste downloads the tool and opens the creation page in your browser. Next time, the same line is enough. If Python is not on your machine, you will be prompted to install it automatically.
ui.أوامر الأداة، وأوامر ومهارات الوكلاء، وا: The tool's commands, the agents' commands and skills, and the companion tools. Press "Copy" and paste.
ui.بعد الإنشاء افتح <b>Office/Project Offic: After creation, open Office/Project Office.html, then talk to the Compass alone; it distributes the work across the team.

title: Project Forge | نظام تشغيل لفريق وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي
Project Forge | An operating system for a team of AI agents

cli.new: Creates a complete project: folders, rules, board, role files, start commands and the management site.
cli.build: Rebuilds the management site from the board. Add --open to open it.
cli.watch: Rebuilds automatically whenever the board, the team or the decision log changes.
cli.rows: Shows the rows ready to start for a given role (those whose requirements are complete).
cli.add-row: Adds a row to the board safely: automatic number, collision prevention, and a cap on open rows.
cli.set-status: Changes a row's status. The statuses «معتمدة» (approved) and «ملغاة» (cancelled) require --owner-order, the project owner's order.
cli.add-role: Adds a new role and updates the rules, the commands and the site.
cli.decide: Records a decision in the decision log with automatic numbering.
cli.report: Performance report: delivery rate, cycle time, quality pass rate, load per role and overdue decisions. Saved in Docs/Reports.
cli.export: Exports the board, team, decisions and indicators to CSV (UTF-8 with BOM).
cli.check: Checks the project: naming, numbering, board integrity, decision deadlines and the presence of a Head of Quality Assurance.
cli.register: Registers the project in the Compass hub registry (Registry.md).
cli.selftest: Tests the tool on a temporary project and reports whether each step passed.

tools.Project Forge: The parent tool: a single Python file with no external libraries, which builds the project, its team and its site.
tools.Project Office: A management site generated for every project in a single HTML file: home, follow-up, tasks, team, diagram, commands and settings.
tools.Start Office: A launch script that opens the site and keeps it updated automatically (macOS).
tools.Report: A periodic performance report from the board and status history: delivery, cycle time, quality pass, load and decisions.
tools.Export CSV: Four CSV files for analysis and reporting.
tools.Smoke test: A browser test (Playwright) that checks every page and tab in light, dark and mobile.

agents: Start an employee chat
Paste it into a new chat. It introduces the employee to its role and points it to its assignment file.
You are "1. Product Lead: reference, decisions and plan". Read Agents/Roles/رئيس المنتج.md, then continue.
Run an existing chat
One word makes the employee read the board and carry out its ready rows.
continue
Closing command
Before closing a long chat: saves everything to the folder and writes a handoff file.

I am closing this chat and opening a new one for you to continue the same work. The new chat will see nothing from here; its only reference is the folder, so anything you do not write into the folder now is lost. Carry out these steps in order without asking me:

1. Stop any running work at the nearest safe point, and save every incomplete output at its path under a name that marks it as a draft. Nothing stays only in the chat.
2. Write the handoff file `Agents/Handoffs/[your role name] [number].md`, containing: what you completed with the path of each file, the work in progress (the row number and the exact next step), what the project owner said in this chat that is not yet written down, what you tried that failed and why, the open questions, and what the new chat must read first.
3. Anything that is a standing rule, write as a row to the Compass; anything that needs the project owner's decision, write as a line in section 1 of the board.
4. Update "next" in every open row under your name, and update your row in "team status".
5. Verify by reading the files from disk that all of the above is actually saved.
6. Your reply is two lines: the path of the handoff file, then "safe to close" or what prevents it. If the folder is not connected, write "not safe to close: the folder is not connected".
Resume command
In a new chat in place of the closed one: continues from where the predecessor stopped.

You are "[full chat name as in the team table]", resuming the work of a previous chat of yours that was closed. You cannot see that chat; your only reference is the folder. Carry out these steps in order without asking me:

1. Read `CLAUDE.md`.
2. Read `Agents/Roles/[your role name].md`; its constants apply throughout the chat.
3. Read your latest file in `Agents/Handoffs/` in full, then only what it names.
4. Read your rows in `Agents/Board.md` and their "next", and the last two circulars in section 2.
5. If the handoff file conflicts with the board, the board is newer and prevails; flag it to me in one line.
6. Continue the work in progress from "next step" without redoing what is done, then the rest of your ready rows in order of their numbers.
7. If the folder is not connected, say so in one line, and do not claim to have read anything.

Your reply: one line confirming where you are resuming from, then three lines: what you did, what awaits others, and what you need from me.
Quality verdict request
Asks the Head of Quality Assurance for an independent verdict: pass or fail.

You are the "Head of Quality Assurance". Review the output of row [number] at the path stated on the board against the acceptance criteria in the reference, write your verdict in Docs/QA/ in the form: pass / fail with the reasons ordered by severity, then update the row status.
First request to the Compass
After creating the project: start with the Compass alone and it distributes the work.

You are "Compass: general direction". Read CLAUDE.md, then Agents/Board.md. Our goal: [goal]. Turn it into complete rows on the board, one per specialist, and tell me each row number and whom to start with first.
Before and after automation
For the process analyst: measures the process before automation so it can be compared after.

You are the "Process Analyst". Choose the recurring process named in your row, draw it step by step, and measure for each step: the time, who performs it, how many times it repeats weekly, and the common errors. Save the result in Data/Before.csv with the columns: step, owner, minutes, weekly runs, errors. Then write in "next" the steps that are candidates for automation, ordered by impact.
Design an agent for a process
For the automation engineer: designs the agent before building it, with a specification to review.

You are the "Automation Engineer". Design an agent for the process in your row with a six-part specification: the inputs and their source, the outputs and their form, the rules it never breaks, the points of human intervention, how it is measured after launch, and the approved tools from Docs/Data Policy.md. Save it in Outputs/ and hand the row to the Head of Quality Assurance with the status "بانتظار التدقيق".
End-of-day report
Summarises the state and shows what awaits the project owner's decision.
Read Agents/Board.md and give me in five lines: what was delivered today, what awaits review, what awaits my decision with your recommendation for each, and the main blocker.

cliCmd.new: python3 -I "Project Forge 1.py" new "Project name" --goal "Project goal" --owner "The Chairman" --preset transformation --language English --yes
